author: DeltaCube6666
body:
Use a nekro staff instead of forest goat (it's an instrument and you can't get sequencer bonuses with it), positive status amity, high mag or lugus as second accessory, fill rift helmet with azure pinions

Alternatively use a 2h celestial staff with pact adorn, zwei fencer spec and 2 arisen trev charms 

Spells summon dead, very scary skeleton, ghosts, you can use sphinx kit as a cleanse bot against heavy debuffing raids or fey kelpie against tower titans and hyperion to disable ward
